facts.business: Glottis Limited is an integrated logistics and supply chain partner providing end-to-end solutions across Air Freight, Ocean Freight, Break Bulk, 3PL & Warehousing, Land Transport, and Multimodal services globally.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Revenue Recognition - significant judgement in determining whether the Company acts as a principal or an agent under Ind AS 115, and assessment of revenue cut-off, unbilled revenue and accrual of related freight and logistics costs.

key_risks: Softer global freight environment and evolving trade dynamics
Revenue recognition judgement (principal vs agent under Ind AS 115)
Revenue cut-off and unbilled revenue estimation
Accrual of related freight and logistics costs
